title: 經國號與航空製造概念
summary: 以經國號研製歷史為起點，學習通用飛機結構、材料追溯、系統整合與驗證管理。
summaryEn: Use the IDF development history to study general aircraft structures, material traceability, integration and verification management.
scope: 航空史與通用工程概念；不含武器、火控、戰術、作戰性能優化或真機建造指示。
scopeEn: Aviation history and general engineering concepts only; excludes weapons, fire control, tactics, combat optimization and instructions to construct an operational aircraft.

steps.title: 定位研製歷程
steps.objective: 完成「定位研製歷程」的概念模型與工程檢核。
steps.objectiveEn: Build and review the conceptual model for place development milestones.

knowledge.title: 核心原理
knowledge.text: 原型出廠、首飛與量產是不同里程碑，不能用單一日期代表完整研製。
knowledge.textEn: Prototype rollout, first flight and production are different milestones in aircraft development.

knowledge.title: 總工程師檢核
knowledge.text: 依公開資料建立三類里程碑時間軸。
knowledge.textEn: Build a timeline with three distinct milestone types from public sources.

steps.check: 依公開資料建立三類里程碑時間軸。
steps.checkEn: Build a timeline with three distinct milestone types from public sources.

quiz.question: 哪個敘述最直接說明「定位研製歷程」的核心原理？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains place development milestones?
options: 原型出廠、首飛與量產是不同里程碑，不能用單一日期代表完整研製。
結構與品質管理概念可用非飛行比例模型表達，不需要作戰功能。
每項需求應連到設計決策與驗證證據，避免只有漂亮外形。
optionsEn: Prototype rollout, first flight and production are different milestones in aircraft development.
Structural and quality concepts can be represented by a non-flying scale model without combat functions.
Each requirement should link to a design decision and verification evidence.
quiz.explanation: 原型出廠、首飛與量產是不同里程碑，不能用單一日期代表完整研製。
quiz.explanationEn: Prototype rollout, first flight and production are different milestones in aircraft development.
